claim: Register the rendered official Lassonde Art Trail Fall 2026 map (1800x1273) onto the city world frame with Captain-read control pixels matched by name to verified WGS84 controls, report residuals and leave-one-out, and hold out the Atlas Crane. The primary fit adds the Commissioners Street Bridge road-crossing centre to break the near-collinearity of the original four. The map is a stylised illustration; the affine is map-pixel -> world-metre, not a WGS84 datum transform. Art label anchors are text anchors, not sculpture centres.

map.source: Lassonde Art Trail, Fall 2026 map PDF (LAT_MAP_DOWNLOAD-Fall2026.pdf)
map.scaleNote: Task-fixed 1800/1190.55 for both axes; the rendered height ratio (1273/841.89) differs by ~0.01%, ignored.
map.orientationNote: Stylised trail illustration; do not assume north-up or a geographic datum.
map.datumNote: MAP-PDF SPACE is a printed illustration in PDF points. WORLD SPACE is the city tangent-plane projection (js/city-config.js worldFromLatLon). The affine below is a 2D pixel->metre fit between them, NOT a WGS84 datum transform.

controls.name: cherry_commissioners_jct
controls.osmRef: derived: Cherry Street x Commissioners Street way intersection (Overpass 2026-11-10)

controls.name: polson_cherry_jct
controls.osmRef: derived: Polson Street x Cherry Street way intersection (Overpass 2026-11-10)

fit5.label: PRIMARY: 5 controls (original 4 + Commissioners bridge road-crossing centre)
fit5.model: affine: world = A * [px, py, 1] (least squares, dense normal equations); separate coefficients per axis

conditioning.note: The original three non-firehall controls remain nearly collinear (min angle 6.6 deg), but the added Commissioners bridge supplies an off-line constraint: the normal-matrix determinant rises and the leave-one-out max falls from 321.74 m to 58.36 m. Residuals and leave-one-out are reported unmodified; no control was pruned.

holdout.name: atlas_crane
holdout.note: Held out from both fits; compared against the actual OSM node/9521067431 point in osm-verified.json.

reasons: 5-control Atlas Crane holdout 32.77 m (limit 50 m) -> pass
4-control comparison: RMS 9.56 m, holdout 45.98 m, LOO max 321.74 m

corrections.oldClaim: The Fall 2026 map proves the works are installed on site.
corrections.correctedClaim: The Fall 2026 map is a published current/planned trail route. It does not independently prove on-site installation. The First Sun artist page still says the work is currently installed at Doris C. Freedman Plaza, NYC (run ended 2026-08-03), so the Toronto installation is not independently verified by a dated primary opening source in this pass. Map markers are approximate source positions only.
corrections.action: Recorded here; the old source doc was not edited because this pass owns only the three new files.
